tagline: 禄来数码单反相机，1988 年发布
description: 禄来于1988年推出的数码单反相机。配备Bayonet mount Rollei (license built Carl Zeiss) Planar 2.8/80mm with HFT coating.。使用6x6 or 4.5x6 on 120 or 220 film types, depending on exchangeable film magazine used.。

specs.胶片/画幅: 6x6 or 4.5x6 on 120 or 220 film types, depending on exchangeable film magazine used.
specs.镜头: Bayonet mount Rollei (license built Carl Zeiss) Planar 2.8/80mm with HFT coating.
specs.英文简介: The Rolleiflex 6008 Professional is a medium format SLR system camera manufactured by Rollei, Braunschweig, Germany.
